end.summary:
Asha practised counting sides and corners of 2D shapes.
Ayaan identified triangles, rectangles, squares, diamonds, and circles from their features.
They counted sides and corners accurately across the recorded attempts.
Ayaan noticed that one side had been counted twice and corrected the total to four.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Ayaan practised naming shapes by counting their sides and corners, including shapes shown in different positions. Tracing each edge once and matching the count to the corners worked well; they also corrected a double-counted side during the lesson. The cut-shape example brought some uncertainty and was not clearly settled by the end. At home, ask Ayaan to trace and count the sides and corners of a triangle, rectangle, square, and circle, saying the number aloud.
